# faf_sim_math_tests known differences on linux-x64 from tests/sim_math/golden.txt (plan WPL.23).
# Reason: glibc's libm (through msvc8::acos/asin/acosf/asinf for |x| > 1 or NaN, and msvc8::fmod for an infinite dividend or a zero divisor) returns +NaN where the Windows x64 UCRT returns the negative x87 indefinite NaN, and the reverse for fmod. Only NaN signs; to be removed by WPL.11 (engine implementations instead of host libm).
